page_title: PAR 0-2 CRE | Parma v Cremonese 21/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) receives a yellow card for chasing the referee and shouting at him.
90+3' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Michael Fabbri's book.
90+2' The game has begun to heat up. Mariano Troilo (Parma) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90+1' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Martin Payero (Cremonese) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Some great controlled play and passing from Parma. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Matteo Bianchetti makes his way off the pitch and Francesco Folino (Cremonese) comes on as his replacement.
85' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
85' Parma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
83' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. A free kick is awarded to Cremonese.
81' Parma hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.

71' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:4.

68' 0 - 2 Jamie Vardy finds Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the right post. What a clinical finish to make it 0:2.
67' Marco Giampaolo has decided to substitute Antonio Sanabria and he is replaced by Jamie Vardy (Cremonese).

63' Parma are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
60' Carlos Cuesta prepares a substitution. Oliver Sorensen is replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Parma).

60' Parma players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball is out of play. Cremonese will take a throw-in.
60' The substitution is prepared. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alessandro Circati.
58' The Parma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
56' Total attempts – 3:3.

54' 0 - 1 Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1 with this magnificent strike.
52' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
50' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
49' Parma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

45+2' The match has reached half-time.

43' Mandela Keita (Parma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul. Cremonese are awarded a free kick.
42' Cremonese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
40' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) takes the corner but it's cleared.
37' Parma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
35' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) commits a foul and Michael Fabbri immediately signals a free kick.
34' The Cremonese players are exchanging some short passes.
32' Nice passing game by Cremonese. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
28' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

27' It looked like the long-range shot by Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
26' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
24' A goal, which was scored by Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese), was disallowed due to offside.

21' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
20' Ball possession – 43:57.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Cremonese.
16' The ball is cleared after Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
14' The referee blows his whistle as Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) was too aggressive in his challenge.
13' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Parma are taking a throw-in.
11' Great teamplay by Parma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
7' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle as Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
7' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) will take a corner kick.

6' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Zion Suzuki is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. Cremonese win a corner kick.
5' Michael Fabbri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Parma in a dangerous position.
